pages.text: Successfully use an obtained Infernal Forge, Void Forge, Void Core or Gauntlet of Guard native ground/control action.

pages.title: The Ground Answers
pages.text: Use earned forge and void artifacts to control space.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Infernal Forge uses a block for an area strike; Void Forge creates a rune fan. Void Core creates runes, Guard pulls entities and Maelstrom creates a vortex. Brontes is thrown. These are alternative actual actions; acquire the artifacts normally first.
